# Univariate feature signal for the same-state switch benefit (exploratory; generated by scripts/m3_feature_signal.py)

y = log2(PAR2 after switching to F− at K / PAR2 staying NATIVE) on decision points that are not censored on both sides; negative y = switching helps. ρ: Spearman over instances; ρ_within: after subtracting family-group means from feature and y.


## K = 1000: 342 uncensored decision points, 66 family groups; switch better on 143, stay better on 199

| feature | n | rho | rho_within |
|---|---|---|---|
| s_antihorn_frac | 342 | -0.24 | -0.03 |
| x_irr_per_var | 342 | 0.21 | 0.05 |
| w_native_pos_frac | 342 | -0.21 | 0.02 |
| w_neg_dec_frac | 342 | 0.21 | -0.02 |
| c_neg_dec_frac | 342 | 0.21 | -0.02 |
| c_native_pos_frac | 342 | -0.21 | 0.02 |
| c_target_src_frac | 342 | 0.21 | -0.00 |
| w_target_src_frac | 342 | 0.21 | -0.00 |
| w_saved_src_frac | 342 | -0.21 | 0.00 |
| c_saved_src_frac | 342 | -0.21 | 0.00 |
| s_cv_ratio | 342 | 0.19 | 0.04 |
| c_reuse_frac | 342 | 0.19 | 0.01 |

| result_base | n | switch_better | median_y |

| UNSAT | 154 | 0.49 | 0.01 |
